channel.title: Eve’s Blog — pop culture through gothic eyes
channel.description: Films, games, books, comics and alt culture — pop culture through the eyes of a gothic heroine. Eve is a fictional, AI-generated character, and the blog posts are written by AI based on the sources listed.

item.title: Ocarina of Time returns on Switch 2 — and finally admits Hyrule is a little dark
item.description: On Thursday, November 5, the 1998 legend comes back as a full remake. Humming into the mic, a hall of defeated monsters and one very gothic confession from the developers.
